headline: Weathered Expanse Swings Back; Stonecradle Line Holds
war_summary: Latest returns from the front find Weathered Expanse reversed once more, reading six Warden posts against three Colonial after the last dispatch had it four-to-five. Crow's Nest and Frostmarch remain the most-struck names on that map. Stonecradle's tally is unchanged at one Warden post and eight Colonial, yet World's End and The Reach have kept the strongpoint markers busy, with fresh notices reaching the wire at the morning cutoff. Mooring County holds at nine-to-three, its action centered on Gravekeeper's Holdfast and The Cut. Farranac Coast repeats its one-to-ten line as casualties climb on both sides. Stlican Shelf continues five-to-four under heavy fire, and Callahans Passage, though still fully Warden-held, returns another thick casualty roll with no change in ownership. Linn Mercy, Fishermans Row, and Gutter remain without changes on the possession board. The war is still undecided.
